meta.name: roi-calculator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "calculate influencer ROI", "prove campaign value", or "what was our ROAS"; produces direct ROI/ROAS, earned media value, attribution-modeled revenue, LTV-based ROI, and a stakeholder-ready summary. Not for building the full slide/written report — use report-generator.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算网红营销的投资回报率与归因收入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需向团队或客户证明营销活动的实际价值。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate influencer ROI and attributed revenue instantly.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to prove the value of marketing campaigns to stakeholders.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的花费和结果数据，计算多种 ROI（如直接 ROI、ROAS、EMV、归因收入、基于 LTV 的 ROI），并生成一份包含关键指标和评估结论的摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求“计算网红营销 ROI”、“证明活动价值”或“我们的 ROAS 是多少”，并提供了花费和结果数据时触发。

say.text: 用直接收入、EMV 和 LTV 三种方法分别算 ROI。
say.note: Claude 会对比不同方法的结果。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can calculate multiple ROI metrics (direct ROI, ROAS, EMV, attribution-modeled revenue, LTV-based ROI) based on spend and results data you provide, and generate a summary with key metrics and assessment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "calculate influencer ROI", "prove campaign value", or "what was our ROAS", and provide spend and results data.

say_en.text: Calculate ROI for our influencer campaign: $25K spend, $72K revenue, 2.1M reach.
say_en.note: Claude outputs direct ROI, ROAS, EMV, and assessment.

say_en.text: Calculate ROI using direct revenue, EMV, and LTV-based methods.
